mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has stabilized at -28.1% in the most recent week after declining to -31.0% two weeks prior, indicating a floor effect. failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -28% or declines further below -30%, contradicting the stabilization signal.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within one week of TRANSIT stabilizing above -33%, or TRANSIT falls back below -35% before the one-week window closes.

regime_hint: weather-driven or policy-driven outdoor restriction regime

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL mobility has remained elevated at 12-13% throughout the observation period, indicating sustained work-from-home policy or preference. failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the prior 28-day mean by more than 2 percentage points, or WORKPLACES rises above -15% while RESIDENTIAL falls below 11%.

failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days rises above the prior 14-day mean, or GROCERY_PHARM rebounds to positive territory within one week.
